title: Sheafified action-site cohomology computes higher internal invariants naturally
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small site $P$ of profinite sets with finite jointly surjective covers [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, def-weil-size-convention], and let $J$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group. Write $\mathcal A_J(R)$ for internal $R$-modules with natural $R$-linear actions of $\underline J(S)=C(S,J)$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. Let $\Gamma_{R,J}$ be the invariant submodule functor whose sections are fixed after every profinite base change; use its ordinary total right derived functor and put $R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(M)=H^q(R\Gamma_{R,J}(M[0]))$ [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus, def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

Let $P_J$ be the site of profinite continuous left $J$-spaces with finite jointly surjective equivariant coverings, $t:P\to P_J$ the trivial-action functor, and $\Phi:\mathcal A_J(R)\simeq\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal R_J)$ the normalized exact additive equivalence, with $\mathcal R_J=\Phi(R)$, in [lem-sfb-profinite-action-coherent-presentation]. Thus $\Phi(M)(tS)=\Gamma_{R,J}(M)(S)$ naturally in $M$ and $S$. For $M\in\mathcal A_J(R)$ and $q\geq0$, define the abelian presheaf
$$P^q_M(S)=H^q(tS,\Phi(M)_{ab})$$
using object cohomology and its restriction maps [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]; the suffix $ab$ forgets the ring-sheaf module structure [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category].

For every nonnegative injective resolution $M\to Q^\bullet$ in $\mathcal A_J(R)$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], the canonical acyclic-resolution comparison gives an isomorphism of presheaves
$$\bigl(S\longmapsto H^q(\Gamma_{R,J}(Q^\bullet)(S))\bigr)\xrightarrow{\sim}P^q_M.$$
This comparison is independent of resolution up to the canonical comparison isomorphisms and is natural in equivariant coefficient maps and continuous maps of profinite parameters. In particular, writing $U$ for forgetting an internal $R$-module to its abelian sheaf and $\#$ for abelian sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], it induces a natural isomorphism
$$\alpha_M^q:(P^q_M)^\#\xrightarrow{\sim}U(R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(M)).$$
For every equivariant map $f:M\to M'$, its naturality is the equality
$$U(R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(f))\circ\alpha_M^q=\alpha_{M'}^q\circ(P^q_f)^\#,$$
where $P^q_f(S)=H^q(tS,\Phi(f)_{ab})$. No exactness of section evaluation at arbitrary profinite $S$, no discreteness and no cohomological-dimension bound are assumed.

proof.text: Put $F=\Phi(M)$ and $I^\bullet=\Phi(Q^\bullet)$. The normalized equivalence is exact and additive by [lem-sfb-profinite-action-coherent-presentation]; [lem-weil-pbc-equivalence-injective-resolutions] therefore makes $F\to I^\bullet$ a nonnegative module-injective resolution. Its augmentation is a quasi-isomorphism and is degreewise monomorphic: the degree-zero map is the kernel inclusion, and in other degrees its source is zero. The normalization gives a natural identification of underlying abelian complexes $I^\bullet(tS)=\Gamma_{R,J}(Q^\bullet)(S)$, compatible with the differentials and every parameter restriction: apply the stated natural section identification in each degree.

source.place: Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images), first sentence; transport uses homology.tex Tag 015Z (lemma-adjoint-preserve-injectives).

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-module-resolution-derived-presheaf-comparison] on the small site $P_J$ with commutative ring sheaf $\mathcal R_J$, coefficient $F$, and this resolution. Choose an abelian injective resolution $F_{ab}\to A^\bullet$. That node gives a comparison $b:I^\bullet_{ab}\to A^\bullet$ whose underlying presheaf map is a quasi-isomorphism, independent up to homotopy. Evaluate at $tS$. Presheaf cohomology is objectwise by [lem-weil-pbc-site-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact](1), with constant ring $\mathbf Z$. Thus $H^q(b(tS))$ is an isomorphism to $H^q(tS,F_{ab})$, the latter computed by $A^\bullet$ as in [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology](2). Together with step 1 it is the required acyclic comparison $\beta_Q:B_Q^q\xrightarrow{\sim}P_M^q$, where $B_Q^q(S)=H^q(\Gamma_{R,J}Q^\bullet(S))$. For $a:S'\to S$, the equation $A^\bullet(ta)b(tS)=b(tS')I^\bullet_{ab}(ta)$ is naturality of $b$. Taking cohomology proves compatibility with the cohomological restrictions, hence gives an isomorphism of presheaves.

source.place: Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), injective-module acyclicity; derived.tex Tag 015E (lemma-leray-acyclicity); restriction mapping preceding Tag 072W.

proof.text: For $f:M\to M'$ and a resolution $Q'^\bullet$, lift $\Phi(f)$ between the transported module-injective resolutions by [lem-sfb-module-resolution-derived-presheaf-comparison]. Full faithfulness of $\Phi$ lifts that chain map back to $\widetilde f:Q^\bullet\to Q'^\bullet$: the equations for differentials and augmentations hold because they do after applying the faithful functor. The same comparison node asserts $c_{\Phi Q'}\,Q(\iota U\Phi\widetilde f)=R\iota(U\Phi f)\,c_{\Phi Q}$. Taking cohomology and evaluating at $tS$ gives $\beta_{Q'}H^q(\Gamma_{R,J}\widetilde f)(S)=P_f^q(S)\beta_Q$. Its homotopy uniqueness makes this independent of the lift and, with $f=\mathrm{id}$, independent of the resolution. These are comparisons of the entire presheaf complexes, so the equalities also commute with every parameter restriction.

source.place: Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), normalized derived comparison; derived.tex Tags 013P (lemma-morphisms-lift) and 013S (lemma-morphisms-equal-up-to-homotopy).

proof.text: Set $K^\bullet=\Gamma_{R,J}(Q^\bullet)$, a complex of internal $R$-modules representing $R\Gamma_{R,J}(M[0])$ by [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus]. The monoidal sheafification in [sk-def-sfb-sheaf-tensor] supplies the monoidal-localization hypothesis of [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. That equivalence identifies internal modules with sectionwise module sheaves and preserves their underlying abelian sheaves identically. Under this equivalence scalar forgetting is exact by [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful](1), so $UH^q(K)=H^q(UK)$. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-site-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact](2) with $\mathbf Z$ to the underlying presheaf complex $UK$: its cohomology presheaf is $B_Q^q$, and termwise sheafification recovers $UK$. Consequently there is a canonical isomorphism $\eta_Q:(B_Q^q)^\#\xrightarrow{\sim}U(R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(M))$. Define $\alpha_M^q=\eta_Q\circ(\beta_Q^\#)^{-1}$. This proves the sheafified comparison without asserting exactness of evaluation on sheaves.

source.place: Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images), cohomology sheaf as associated presheaf of kernels modulo images; Tag 03FD, exactness of scalar forgetting.

proof.text: The resolution formula [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-map-via-lift], applied to the additive left exact invariant functor, identifies $R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(f)$ with the map induced by $\Gamma_{R,J}(\widetilde f)$. Naturality of the sheafification/cohomology isomorphism in [lem-weil-pbc-site-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact](2) therefore gives $U(R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(f))\eta_Q=\eta_{Q'}(H^q\Gamma_{R,J}\widetilde f)^\#$. Step 3 gives $(H^q\Gamma_{R,J}\widetilde f)^\#(\beta_Q^\#)^{-1}=(\beta_{Q'}^\#)^{-1}(P_f^q)^\#$. Composing these equalities proves exactly $U(R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(f))\alpha_M^q=\alpha_{M'}^q(P_f^q)^\#$. Taking $f=\mathrm{id}$ proves independence for $\alpha$ as well. All constructions are defined for every $q\geq0$ and all parameters in the fixed small sites.
